constraints: Production uses Python implementations; no JS/Node/browser subprocess or interpreter.
Existing py-skia-canvas native rendering is retained through public APIs; no new native renderer introduced.
Equivalent means source-observable behavior verified by changed-surface differential checks; no inferred parity from package names.

Trace retained semantic and algorithm surfaces to Python responsibilities. Discard DOM/browser mechanisms under user authorization and document how required features are reimplemented; functional exclusions still require evidence.
Do not emulate DOM/virtual DOM, CSS browser layout, D3 selection or browser render scheduling in Python.
